reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: This diagnosis-related stay is not named in the policy, but the policy applies broadly to inpatient and outpatient facility claims billed on UB04. Routine room and board, supplies, nursing care, equipment, and listed ancillary components are included in the facility payment and are not separately reimbursable.

utilization_limits: 1 unit/day for facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-370, 410, 412, 419, 460, and 510 as inclusive facility charges when billed on the same UB04 claim for the same inpatient or outpatient visit; exempt Pre- and Post-Anesthesia Recovery Room. Exempt: Pre- and Post-Anesthesia Recovery Room.

IA — Limit revenue code 761 to 1 unit/day for facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management on UB04 inpatient facility claims.
